scope: Raw adjacent Double Tap + Rampage evidence. constructed_input_scope: One scenario Rampage and a living Blue Slaver; recorded player resources, Double Tap and target HP/block/Strength. Original unrelated cards, relics and dead slime are omitted. Java UUID continuity remains Java-local. No Java UUID is assigned to a Rust lineage.
observation_limit: Java stable frames observe aggregate damage 21 and persistent base damage 8->18, not an individual-hit trace. The 8 then 13 hit sequence follows from the original Rampage/ModifyDamage/DoubleTap code and is not labeled as separately recorded hit evidence. RNG non-consumption is checked independently on each endpoint; initial cross-runtime RNG state equality is outside this constructed scope.
